statements.sentence: At 1x the image has the size written on the root element of the SVG; with only a viewBox, the viewBox size; with neither, 300 × 150. Scale takes any number above 0. Width and Height take a whole number of pixels from 1 to 65,535 and work…
statements.statement: At 1x the image has the size written on the root element of the SVG; with only a viewBox, the viewBox size; with neither, 300 × 150. Scale takes any number above 0. Width and Height take a whole number of pixels from 1 to 65,535 and work out the other side from the aspect ratio. Width × height sets both sides; when the ratio differs from the SVG, the drawing is placed as its preserveAspectRatio says. A side can be at most 65,535 px, within the canvas limit of the browser.
statements.qualification: Matches intrinsicSize/planOutput/MAX_SIDE; 65,535 and 300 × 150 are the code values.

statements.statement: JPEG and WebP show a Quality box (1-100, 92 when empty or out of range). JPEG has no transparency, so transparent areas are filled with white. When the browser cannot encode the chosen format, the file is saved in the format the browser returns and a note says so. Transparent keeps alpha in PNG and WebP; a fully transparent result of up to 4,194,304 pixels gets a note.
statements.qualification: readOptions quality fallback 0.92; backgroundFor JPEG #ffffff + jpegWhite; formatFallback on blob.type; blank only when no background and w*h <= 4194304.

statements.statement: Files that are not SVG are skipped and listed. Compressed .svgz files cannot be read. The file keeps the SVG name: a scale other than 1 adds @2x, other size modes add -WIDTHxHEIGHT, pasted code is saved as image. Each row has its own download, and Download all (.zip) saves svg-to-png.zip.
statements.qualification: isSvgFile / outputName / zipBtn / save name all match. The skip note calls .svgz "not SVG"; the docs separately state .svgz is unsupported (see limitations).
